# 견적검수실 데이터

Updated: 2026-09-11

This preview separates OFFICIAL, REFERENCE, QUOTE and CALCULATED data. Do not treat public construction standards as private apartment market averages.

## Primary datasets
- https://5ggul.github.io/pm-lab/interior-cost-preview/data/cost-index/ — official construction cost index
- https://5ggul.github.io/pm-lab/interior-cost-preview/data/construction-wage/ — official construction wage survey
- https://5ggul.github.io/pm-lab/interior-cost-preview/data/public-unit-cost/ — public construction unit-cost references; not private market prices
- https://5ggul.github.io/pm-lab/interior-cost-preview/data/quote-statistics/ — anonymized quote aggregates; prices withheld below N thresholds
- https://5ggul.github.io/pm-lab/interior-cost-preview/data/catalog/ — dataset catalog and scopes
- https://5ggul.github.io/pm-lab/interior-cost-preview/data/answers/ — concise answer index for common questions
- https://5ggul.github.io/pm-lab/interior-cost-preview/data/dataset-catalog.json — machine-readable dataset catalog
- https://5ggul.github.io/pm-lab/interior-cost-preview/data/answer-index.json — machine-readable answer index
- https://5ggul.github.io/pm-lab/interior-cost-preview/data/quote-intelligence.json — quote coverage and publication status

## Quote publication policy
Overall distribution requires N>=30. Segment price distributions require N>=20. Raw quote rows are not published. Mean is not published.
